### Still Lost, Despite Handheld Directions
Author: Meg Bucher
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women-march-9.html
Passage: Jeremiah 31:3
Points:
- Modern distractions and handheld devices easily steer our focus away from God's leading.
- Even when Israel wandered into disobedience and exile, God remained faithful to them.
- God’s covenant affection cannot be earned by performance or lost through human weakness.
- Calling upon Jesus restores our spiritual direction and anchors the soul in eternal love.

### How God Reacts to Rebellion
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Love Worth Finding
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-february-18-2024.html
Passage: Jeremiah 31:3
Points:
- Adam and Eve illustrate how free beings can rebel even in a loving, perfect environment.
- God personally empathizes with parents enduring the sorrow of a wayward child.
- Rather than forcing obedience like machines, God respects the human will.
- Instead of abandoning rebels, God continually stretches out gracious hands calling them home.

### Love Beyond Doubt
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-december-20-2021.html
Passage: Jeremiah 31:3
Points:
- Christ communicates His deep affection directly to the hearts of His people.
- The internal witness of the Holy Spirit provides unwavering evidence of the Savior’s love.
- Believers walking closely with God experience sweet seasons of profound spiritual assurance.
- Resting securely in God’s everlasting love removes lingering doubts and anxieties.
